assessment.security_status_cs: Zvolení Luize Inácia Lula da Silvy na čtvrté volební období v Brazílii provázejí politické otřesy, včetně útěku poraženého Flávia Bolsonara do USA. Venezuelská politická scéna se po návratu exilové vůdkyně Marie Coriny Machadové a amerických geopolitických tlacích dál radikalizuje, zatímco Ecuador čelí eskalaci násilí organizovaného zločinu.
assessment.security_status_en: The election of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to a fourth presidential term in Brazil is accompanied by severe political turmoil, including defeated Flávio Bolsonaro's flight to the US. Venezuela's political landscape remains highly volatile following the return of exiled leader María Corina Machado and US geopolitical maneuvering, while Ecuador faces a severe escalation of organized crime violence.

recommendations.reason_cs: Přestože Lula vyhrál volby, politická nestabilita, útěk opozice a opozičně kontrolovaný Kongres omezují prostor pro rychlý růst. Doporučujeme vyčkat na stabilizaci vnitřní politické situace.
recommendations.reason_en: Although Lula won the election, political instability, the opposition's flight, and an opposition-controlled Congress limit the room for rapid growth. We recommend waiting for domestic political stabilization.

assessment.forecast_review_en: The previous forecast regarding the escalation of legal and political disputes in Brazil post-election was fully confirmed by Flávio Bolsonaro's flight abroad and the opposition's rejection of the election results.
